stock.description: Operating within the People's Republic of China, Huaibei GreenGold Industry Investment Co., Ltd. is a producer and supplier of various building materials. Their product portfolio encompasses aggregate items such as scalping, sand powder, and general construction aggregates, in addition to concrete solutions including ready-mixed concrete, cement-stabilized macadam, and asphalt concrete. The company primarily serves construction enterprises, building material distributors, and wholesale clients. Established in 2016, its main office is situated in Huaibei, PRC.
